questions.title: Owner tenure
questions.text: How long have the current owners lived here?

questions.title: Roof age
questions.text: How old is the roof?

questions.title: AC age
questions.text: How old is the AC unit? (Note if AC and heat are one combined system.)

questions.title: Heating age
questions.text: How old is the heating system / furnace?

questions.title: Windows
questions.text: How old are the windows? Try opening a few — do they open, close and lock smoothly?

questions.title: Electrical panel
questions.text: How old is the electrical panel / circuit breaker, and how many open breaker slots are available? (Note brand — watch for Federal Pacific or Zinsco.)

questions.title: Foundation
questions.text: Has the foundation been repaired or redone? (Note when, by whom, and any transferable warranty.)

questions.title: Kitchen space
questions.text: How good is the kitchen space and layout?

questions.title: Kitchen style & cabinets
questions.text: How do you like the kitchen style, and is there enough cabinet space?

questions.title: Appliances convey
questions.text: Do the appliances convey (washer, dryer, refrigerator)? (Note which ones.)

questions.title: Renovated bathrooms
questions.text: How many bathrooms have been renovated?

questions.title: Master bath sinks
questions.text: Does the master bath have a double sink?

questions.title: Master on same floor
questions.text: Is the master bedroom on the same floor as the other bedrooms?

questions.title: Natural light
questions.text: How good is the natural lighting?

questions.title: Ceiling height
questions.text: What is the ceiling height?

questions.title: Closet space
questions.text: How is the closet space?

questions.title: Extra storage
questions.text: How much extra storage is there (attic, garage shelving, etc.)?

questions.title: Garage
questions.text: How many cars does the garage fit?

questions.title: Fence
questions.text: Does it have a fence? If not, could one be added? (Note HOA rules.)

questions.title: Shed
questions.text: Does it have a shed? If not, is there room / is it allowed to add one?
